Title: Head of Year 9
Description:
I lead the pastoral team for a year group of 212 students and nine form tutors, and I still teach history to Years 9 to 11.
• Brought Year 9 attendance from 91.8% to 94.6% in two years with a tutor-led morning check-in.
• Rebuilt the options evening so every student leaves with a named adult to ask about their GCSE choices.
• Sit on the group that rewrote the Key Stage 3 humanities curriculum for 2024.

Title: Second in History
Description:
Planned the Key Stage 3 history curriculum with the head of department and mentored new teachers.
• Wrote Sheffield at Work, a Year 8 local-history unit now taught in 11 schools across the city.
• Mentored six trainee and early-career teachers through their first years.
• Year 11 history results rose from 58% to 71% at grade 4 and above.

Title: Teacher of History
Description:
Taught history and citizenship across Key Stages 3 and 4, starting in my training year.
• Led the Year 10 battlefields trip to the Somme and Ypres for four springs, 40 students each time.
• Started a lunchtime history club that became the school's first A level history group.

Title: Teaching Assistant, Key Stage 2
Description: Ran small reading groups in Years 5 and 6 for a year before training to teach.
